// CASE dart_started_futures_collect expect=pass
Future<List<int>> a(List<String> ids, Future<int> Function(String) load) async {
  final pending = ids.map(load).toList();
  final out = <int>[];
  for (final future in pending) {
    out.add(await future);
  }
  return out;
}

// CASE dart_control_serial expect=fire
Future<List<int>> b(List<String> ids, Future<int> Function(String) load) async {
  final out = <int>[];
  for (final id in ids) {
    out.add(await load(id));
  }
  return out;
}

// CASE end expect=pass
